_comment: The WiCAN's image for the charge-interposer's bench, pinned as a tool of its harness (AGENTS.md 'Never build WiCAN firmware from an interposer worktree', user 2026-11-11; the bench baseline's image is a madhouse rebuild of gen-inhibit 7f2d5032 _man, user ruling 2026-11-11 in the interposer reviewer's session). wican_pin.py reads it. The files are not in git: each sits at <wican_image_dir>/<name>, wican_image_dir from the local settings, and must have the size, sha256 and md5 given here. No setting can change an image's files or identity. A re-pin is a new pin here.

source.built: idf.py -B build-tester-man build, ESP-IDF v5.4.2, in a clean detached gen-inhibit worktree at 7f2d5032 on madhouse-debian, by the gen-inhibit tester on 2026-11-11 (reverse-it projects/vtrux/notes/artifacts/gen-inhibit/runs/man7f2d_madhouse, its README and SHA256SUMS, sha256 a6dd8528665fb8189dc578c92213abf6d9fc19a9ae0aaf3deb3a8e14cb0163e0 after its README correction of 2026-11-11)
source.code_hash_read: shared/tools R3, by 7f2d5032's gen-inhibit/vtrux_tools.py image at its pin, the same call as the image the WiCAN held at the pin (NICKY-XPS's step 1d _man, image hash f515a383b399c6a958f481c9d241c14148cfa0ead016f91b7ac77bbad3f9151b): the same code hash, the two .bin files differing only in the descriptor's elf_sha256 and the trailing checksum and hash (65 bytes)

image.image_hash_read: the app descriptor's elf_sha256, equal to the ELF's sha256 (wican-fw_obd_man.elf beside the .bin)
